integrity: The range factor follows from a positive-semidefinite Bergman coefficient expansion, the valence factor from the holomorphic area formula for the derivative-weighted composition operator, and the sample-size factor from the published finite-point Schwarz–Pick theorem. Sharpness is verified by an exact Fourier-mode eigenvalue calculation for power maps, not by finite sampling.
scientific_limitations: An exact class-uniform Loewner bound for finite-point Bergman matrices of holomorphic maps with an image-radius bound and bounded valence. It does not claim optimality for a fixed map or point tuple, nor give a counterpart for arbitrary target domains or weighted Bergman kernels.
title: Sharp range–valence constant for finite-point Schwarz–Pick matrices
